# bugs #3886: A compound literal that initializes a struct in a declaration gets no storage

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3886/
- Category: [Already fixed in trunk](../../fixed-upstream.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Close as fixed in r16747.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The ticket reports that `S r = (S){.p = "..."};` inside a function leaves the compound literal
without storage. The instruction that reads the literal then has an empty operand, which the
assembler rejects for z80. A comment of 2026-08 reports the empty operand for mcs51 too.

r17176 compiles these forms correctly. Two test files were used. The first file is the reduced case
of the third comment. The second file has the initializer written directly, through a macro, and as
`&((wrapper){...})` inside the initializer of another struct. It also returns a struct, passes
structs as arguments, and stores characters of each string at fixed addresses. For mcs51 both files
were compiled with the small, medium, large, and huge models, with `--stack-auto` for small and
large, and with `--std-c2y`. No operand is empty, and in ucsim the second file gives the expected
characters in every model. For z80 and stm8 both files were compiled and assembled without an error
and without an empty operand. They were not run for these two ports.

The declaration `int arr[] = (int[]){1, 2, 3, 4, 5};` of the fifth comment gets
`error 69: struct/union/array '': initialization needs curly braces` for mcs51 and stm8. C requires
a brace-enclosed list or a string literal as the initializer of an array, so the error is correct.

## Fixed by

[r16747](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/16747/), which applied patch #509 and which the last
comment of the ticket names. `gatherAutoInit` in `src/SDCCast.c` turns the initializer list of each
local variable into a tree. The temporary symbol of a compound literal in the list is reachable only
after that step, which follows the pass that attaches such symbols to their block. Before r16747
the symbol therefore got neither storage nor a name. Since r16747 `gatherAutoInit` calls
`gatherImplicitVariables` on each tree, allocates the temporary symbols with `allocVariables`, and
places the initializer of each temporary before the initializer that reads it. The revision also
adds two tests for this construct to `support/regression/tests/compound-literal.c`.
